dataset.question: Can a path parameter become optional by setting its default to None?
dataset.reference_answer: No. Path parameters are always required, even when a default or None is declared.

evidence.quote: A path parameter is always required as it has to be part of the path. Even if you declared it with `None` or set a default value, it would not affect anything, it would still be always required.
